text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Fees (Central Narcotics Bureau) (Copies of Statements, Reports, Information, Documents and Records) Order.

2. There shall be leviable at the office of the Central Narcotics Bureau the following fees:
(a)for a copy of every statement recorded from any person under section 122 of the Criminal Procedure Code (Cap. 68)
…
$16
(b)for every search for a statement, report, information, document or record in the possession of the Bureau
…
$14
(c)for a copy of every document or record in the possession of the Bureau
…
$16.
